purpose: Validation-only cross-domain confirmation of the prediction-connected MambaTSv3 AutoCon fusion with seven same-source baselines.
research_question: Does the frozen prediction-connected AutoCon fusion remain competitive outside traffic-speed data on ETTh1, Weather, Exchange-Rate, and ILI coordinates?
architecture: MambaTSv3 uses one shared Mamba-1 patch scan; the AutoCon representation is connected to the forecast through a zero-initialized low-rank temporal residual. The representation objective remains train-only and uses the existing AutoCon contrastive/relationship loss.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only. No test metrics or predictions are generated. A pass permits a separately registered held-out release; a failure stops the corresponding dataset branch.
claim_boundary: This matrix cannot establish universal forecasting, causal AutoCon attribution, long-horizon superiority, or hardware-independent speed.

required_before_launch: verify four dataset hashes and exact 96-job expansion
freeze candidate fusion and baseline contracts
run all phases under the immutable launch sidecar
preserve source snapshot and output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The fusion mechanism and lambda are fixed before this matrix; no dataset may select a different architecture or hyperparameter.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: Baselines receive no candidate-only AutoCon fusion or relation-loss flags; capacity and resource signatures are reported separately.

phases.name: fusion_candidate_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 prediction-connected AutoCon fusion candidate on three standard H96 datasets.

phases.name: fusion_baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-source H96 baseline context for ETTh1, Weather, and Exchange-Rate.

phases.name: fusion_candidate_ili_h48_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen fusion candidate on the standard ILI H48 coordinate.

stopping_rules: Stop a dataset branch if candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest baseline.
Do not claim AutoCon causal gain unless the fusion candidate is compared with its exact lambda-zero control in a separately registered mechanism screen.
Do not release held-out test for a failed dataset branch.
